name: China Coast Guard Academy
zh: 中国人民武装警察部队海警学院
aliases: People's Armed Police China Coast Guard Academy
People's Armed Police Coast Guard Academy

evidence.summary: CASI’s translation of the PLA’s 2024 academy recruitment plan lists the PAP Coast Guard Academy among the four People’s Armed Police academies that admitted officer cadets that year. Under the Central Military Commission’s 2025 admissions plan it no longer admits school-leavers directly: cadets for coast guard vessel-command and law-enforcement posts now enter through Dalian Naval Academy and PAP Engineering University, and the later specialist stage is still taught by the academies concerned.

The academy belongs to the PAP, which since the reforms of 2017–2018 has answered to the Central Military Commission alone; the China Coast Guard, the force its officer cadets join, moved from State Council to PAP command on 1 July 2018.
